name: Turar Ryskulov
contribution: A Soviet politician, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Turkestan Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic.
legacy: This person proposed that Turkestan should be an independent republic ruled by a Turkic Communist Party, separate from the All-Russian Communist Party

checks.lead: Turar Ryskululy Ryskulov (Kazakh: Тұрар Рысқұлұлы Рысқұлов, Tūrar Rysqūlūly Rysqūlov; Russian: Турар Рыскулович Рыскулов; 26 December 1894 – 10 February 1938) was a Soviet politician, the chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Turkestan Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic (i.e. the head of state).
